notes.title: FOMOGRAPHY - Out Now!
notes.notes:
FOMOGRAPHY is officially released on Steam!

Check out the new launch trailer, offering a glimpse into the photogenic world of FOMOGRAPHY, where memory, exploration and emotion intertwine in a philosophical journey through time.

[previewyoutube=GK9ULdzD1Sw;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]FOMOGRAPHY places players in the shoes of an aging man confronting memory loss, reliving his life through photographs taken as a child. Guided only by a camera and fading recollections, players will traverse the landscapes of his past; capturing moments, solving mysteries, and uncovering the truths behind what was remembered, what was forgotten, and what was never meant to be seen.

From Australian forests, subterranean caves, and lively towns full of character, every environment is alive with detail and discovery. Players will meet a diverse cast from the protagonist’s past, each with stories to tell and requests to fulfill, often requiring a keen eye for picture-taking.

Customize your camera with a variety of lenses, filters, and guides to reflect your personal style. Chronicle your journey in an evolving photo album, filled with snapshots that tell a story, one memory at a time.[/i]

Thanks for all the support! We look forward to hearing your feedback about the game!

notes.title: FOMOGRAPHY releases on May 29, 2025!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We are happy to announce that FOMOGRAPHY will be released on May 29, 2025!

Check out the new release date trailer that just dropped!

[previewyoutube=Xwd8KBol3L4;full][/previewyoutube]
FOMOGRAPHY is a first-person adventure that invites players to explore the past through the lens of a boy with his camera. Taking on the role of an aging man suffering from memory loss, players are transported through vivid recollections of his youth, navigating a world where time is slipping and moments vanish like faded photographs.

From the wild beauty of Australian forests, to the quiet mystery of subterranean caves, and the vibrancy of a bustling town, players use their camera to solve small mysteries, capture fleeting memories, and connect with unique NPCs. Each encounter unlocks another piece of the protagonist’s forgotten story.

Customize your camera to suit your vision, choose the perfect lens, filter and framing, and chronicle your journey in a personal photo album that grows with each discovery. Snap everything from adorable wildlife, to hidden treasures and emotional truth. Every photo tells a story…

Wishlist today to stay up-to-date on Steam!

notes.title: FOMOGRAPHY - Coming in early 2025!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got some big news to share! FOMOGRAPHY is officially set to launch in early 2025! We’ve been working hard on this project, and with DANGEN Entertainment backing us, we’re excited to bring FOMOGRAPHY to PC and consoles simultaneously!

In FOMOGRAPHY, you’ll step into the shoes of an elderly man reliving his past through the lens of a boy. With your camera, you’ll explore lush Australian forests, eerie caves, and vibrant towns as you piece together memories long forgotten. Every snapshot holds a key to unlocking the next mystery. What stories lie hidden in the images you capture?

As you customize your camera and chronicle your journey, get ready to uncover not just hidden treasures, but deeper truths about life and memory. This adventure is about rediscovery, capturing the moments that matter, and unearthing the mysteries of the past.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to check out our updated announcement trailer! 

[previewyoutube=ggJukNLoYqg;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for being part of this journey with us—we can’t wait for you to experience FOMOGRAPHY in 2025.
